cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I'd love to lend you my umbrella. How long is the proposed loan? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. An open-ended duration. Do you have a guarantor?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Urgency noted. Please sign without dripping on the terms.

mechanism: A runs an umbrella loan as a formal process and helps keep the paperwork dry while still demanding a signature.
confusable: Unlike guarding the umbrella through refusal, A offers it subject to documentation and third-party backing.
comparison: Rain and a protected signature surface differ from defining emotional reassurance at a wedding.
seedUse: D190-b umbrella guarantor and wet terms; S02-b holds cover for B to complete the process.
